summary.en: The Safe sends the amount of ETH you type straight to the recipient you pick, calling no contract. The card asks only for the recipient and the amount, the same as the Safe web app asks when it sends ETH.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 把你填的 ETH 數量直接送到你選的收款人，不呼叫任何合約。卡片只問收款人和金額，跟 Safe web app 送 ETH 時要填的一樣。

text.en: The simplest operation, calling no protocol contract. The only risk is the recipient address: when you add it to the address book, check it against a source outside the chat.
text.zh-TW: 最單純的操作，不呼叫任何協議合約；風險只在收款地址，加進地址簿時要從聊天以外的來源核對。

text.en: If the recipient is a contract (another Safe, for example), it runs its own code when it receives ETH. verify checks every balance and allowance change of your Safe, and any extra movement (even 1 wei) is a MISMATCH. But it cannot see what the other contract records inside it, or what it later does with this ETH.
text.zh-TW: 收款人如果是合約（例如另一個 Safe），收到 ETH 時會執行它自己的程式。verify 檢查你的 Safe 的每一項餘額和授權變化，多動一點點（哪怕 1 wei）就 MISMATCH；但對方合約內部記了什麼、之後怎麼處理這筆 ETH，它看不到。

recommendation.en: When the recipient is a contract, first confirm it can receive ETH. The first time you send to a new address, send a small amount first.
recommendation.zh-TW: 收款人是合約時，先確認它能收 ETH；第一次轉給新地址先送小額。
